note: Audit findings that were looked into (scripts/audit.mjs reports them as settled instead of again). Key: the finding key in data/audit.json. date, who, note: what was found or decided, with the source.

area-new:inv:50.51,-116.14.note: High/Low Voltage, Power Outage, Uptrack and others just west of Lillian and Eileen lakes: no source names this network. It fits the Barbour Rock trails the Columbia Valley Cycling Society proposed (columbiavalleypioneer.com), with no sign they were approved; Mountain Biking BC calls No Respect there unsanctioned. No label until a name is confirmed (c would be 50.5089,-116.1461).

area-thin:Black Mountain.note: sntsk'il'ntən / Black Mountain Regional Park (RDCO) is a small park with a handful of multi-use trails; the label is within 600 m of their middle, 6 is its real size.

area-thin:Seton Ridge.note: One long ridge trail (11.5 km, bicycle=designated), not a network, so 1 is right. Label made tier 2.

area-thin:Nose Hill.note: City of Calgary allows off-road riding in the hilltop multi-use zone where the label sits; most of its paths have no name on OpenStreetMap, which keeps the count low.

area-thin:Fish Creek.note: Alberta Parks signs a singletrack system in Fish Creek (Ice Caves, Sluice, Path No More); most of it has no name on OpenStreetMap, which keeps the count low. Label is beside the mapped singletrack.

area-thin:Kicking Horse.note: Label moved from the Dawn Mountain Nordic and walking paths onto the bike park (Kranky Pants, Buffalo Jump, Devil's Disco). OpenStreetMap has only a few of the park's 35+ km of trails, so the count stays low until mappers add them.

area-plain:Valleycliffe.note: The left-out paths are Chief and Gondola hikes, climbing approaches, dykes and waterfront walks; none is a bike trail.

area-plain:Britannia Beach.note: Informal paths mapped by a climbing mapper (sac_scale=mountain_hiking, some sport=trial, probably motorbike trials lines); no source calls them bike trails. Pretty Slabs and Stepping Stones are already in from alex.

area-plain:Pacific Spirit Park.note: Metro Vancouver multi-use gravel trails (Salish, Hemlock, Imperial, Sasamat...), open to bikes but not singletrack; left as plain paths on purpose (sac_scale=strolling, gravel surface).

area-plain:Rubberhead.note: The left-out names are Larch Hills Nordic ski trails; Shuswap Trails says bikes may use them spring to fall, but they're ski trails, not MTB trails, so they stay plain paths.

area-plain:Burnaby Mountain.note: Gear Jammer Connector added (ratings.js HAND, Komoot / BMBA). Lost Stapler, Ocean 1974, Jamtart and the rest are the Canada Pacific Trials Association motorcycle trials area at Ioco; the others are walks.

area-plain:Knox Mountain.note: Apex Trail and Kathleen Lake Loop added (ratings.js HAND, Tourism Kelowna Knox network story). The rest are walks, boardwalks and the paved Rail Trail and promenade.

area-plain:Eagle Mountain.note: Academy and Eagle Bluff trails added (ratings.js HAND, Singletracks). The rest are Heritage Woods sidewalks, Coquitlam Crunch and David Bikeway; Homerun, Peanut Butter, Upper Backyard and Strong Road Connector had no source beyond Trailforks. Exterminator, Rokalypse and other motorcycle=designated trails show as moto on purpose.

area-plain:Quarry Lake.note: Riders of Rohan, the Highline trails and Reclaimer added (ratings.js HAND, Alberta Parks trail report, The Banff Blog). Powerline Trail and Water Line had no source; the rest are walks.

ratings:pen.note: 6 of 42 rated from Visit Penticton (Swagman ride guide), Mountain Biking BC and Summerland tourism. The Penticton & Area Cycling Association (bikepenticton.com) only links to Trailforks maps; no other open list gives levels.

ratings:wl.note: 4 of 62 rated from First Journey Trails, Explore Cariboo and the Williams Lake Tribune. The club's Fox Mountain map PDF exists but couldn't be read; no open text list gives levels.

ratings:gfk.note: 3 of 21 rated from Christina Lake tourism and Discover Grand Forks; no club or municipal list gives levels for the rest.

ratings:fer.note: 3 of 151 rated from Sacred Rides' top-10 list. The Fernie Trails Alliance has no rating list outside Trailforks; the Fernie Alpine Resort bike park map PDF couldn't be read.

trailhead:n3562422097.note: Radium Lake Trailhead (BC Parks) is a hike-in junction on the Trans Canada Trail bridleway; no road is missing.

trailhead:n269837876.note: 'Intersection' (Calgary Area Trail Mapping Project) is a junction of hiking footways in Kananaskis, not a road trailhead.

trailhead:n269836948.note: Headwall Lake trailhead is a junction on the Headwall Lakes trail in Kananaskis, reached on foot from the Chester Lake parking.

trailhead:n269837611.note: Three Lakes Valley is a junction of the Chester Lake and Three Lakes Valley trails in Kananaskis, not a road trailhead.

trailhead:n5217082970.note: Unnamed trailhead node on an unnamed path near Squamish; no road is missing.

area-new:fv:49.04,-122.06.note: West Vedder Mountain above Yarrow: Recreation Sites and Trails BC lists these as the Vedder Mtn Motor Bike trails, with bikes allowed (tf:official). It's a dirt-bike network riders may share, not an MTB area, so no MTB label; the Vedder Mountain label stays on the MTB trails to the east.

area-plain:Kicking Horse.note: The left-out names are Golden Nordic Club ski, snowshoe and walking loops at Dawn Mountain (The Dike, Wapiti, Ruby's Loop, Beaver, Chickadee); no source says they're ridden. They stay plain paths.

area-plain:Lac du Bois.note: The left-out names are Batchelor Heights neighbourhood walking paths (Edgemount, Garden, Forest, Fulton Field trails) and the paved Rivers Trail, not part of the Batchelor Hills bike network.

area-plain:McQueen Lake.note: The left-out names are the Isobel Lake interpretive and low-mobility walking trails and the Grasslands Community Trail; the McQueen Lake XC loops are already in.

area-thin:Grand Forks.note: Researched 2026-10-17: Grand Forks' town riding is the small Lost Lake / Harpold network off Valley Heights Drive (Discover Grand Forks); 7 is its real size.

area-thin:Merritt.note: Researched 2026-10-17: the label covers the small Swakum set (Tom Lacey, Scenic, Supra, Mojo); Merritt's bigger networks have their own labels (Iron Mountain, Midday Valley) since PR #214.

area-thin:Princeton.note: Researched 2026-10-17: a small in-town hillside network (Forest, Ridge, Bear, Noon, Pipeline); Princeton's main riding, China Ridge, has its own label.

area-thin:Oliver.note: Researched 2026-10-17: a small, unmaintained set of trails on Oliver Mountain up to the cell tower; 7 is its real size.

area-thin:Glenbow Ranch.note: Researched 2026-10-17: Alberta Parks allows bikes on most of the park's gravel and dirt trails, but most are wide multi-use trails, and the zone's west edge (-114.42) cuts off the western trails.

network:pem:Cloudbase Grind.note: A steep hike up to the Pemberton paragliding launch; hiking guides (10Adventures) say not to ride it.

network:kam:Eagle Eye.note: The Eagles Eyrie viewpoint hike at Isobel Lake (Kamloops Hiking Club), not a bike trail.

network:van:Rubber Monkey.note: Inside Mount Seymour Provincial Park, where BC Parks allows bikes only on designated trails, and mapped with closure signs at both ends. Stays off the map.

network:van:Three Chop Trail.note: About 85% inside Mount Seymour Provincial Park; BC Parks allows bikes only on the access road and designated trails, and Three Chop isn't one.

network:sqm:After Work / After Party App.note: Climbers' approach to two Squamish crags, not a bike trail.

ratings:mer.note: 4 of 51 rated from Mountain Biking BC's Merritt day-trip story (2017). The Merritt Mountain Bike Association has no site or map outside Trailforks, and Tourism Merritt gives no levels.

ratings:pri.note: No open source gives levels: Town of Princeton, Discover Princeton and Similkameen Valley pages describe China Ridge without ratings; chinaridge.ca didn't load. Only Trailforks has levels.

ratings:sok.note: No open source gives levels: Visit Oliver has none, Mountain Biking BC only counts trails per level, Destination Osoyoos blocked every request. Only Trailforks has levels.

area-thin:Sugarloaf Mountain.note: A small set east of Merritt (Coco Bonk, Wounded Knee, Pete's New Trail, Deja Vu, Hogs Back); label moved 1.8 km onto their middle. 5 named trails is its real size on OpenStreetMap.

ratings:kel.note: Researched 2026-10-24: 8 more rated from Tourism Kelowna network stories, Visit Westside and KelownaNow. MTBCO's pages embed Trailforks maps only; kmbc.ca, kelowna.ca and Castanet couldn't be read; RDCO pages give no MTB levels. The rest have levels only on Trailforks.

ratings:ver.note: Researched 2026-10-24: Silver Shack rated from the SilverStar trail map PDF. The Vernon-area trails (Big Ed, Tombstone, Pali Gap...) have levels only on Trailforks; Sovereign Lake and Kalamalka (BC Parks) give none.

ratings:cbk.note: Researched 2026-10-24: SW Passage rated from the City of Kimberley trail map PDF; Kimberley Nordic and Cranbrook Community Forest send riders to Trailforks; kimberleytrails.ca didn't load.

ratings:pr.note: Qathet Regional Cycling Association (was Powell River Cycling) puts its trail levels on Trailforks only; Tourism Powell River, Mountain Biking BC and bikepacking.com describe networks but rate no single trail.

ratings:chil.note: Tyax Adventures, BC Parks (South Chilcotin), Recreation Sites and Trails BC and the Bridge River Valley guide give no per-trail levels; blogs quote Trailforks colours. Only Trailforks has levels.

ratings:bnf.note: 10 rated from Parks Canada's Banff-area bike trails (Tunnel Bench Loop, Hoodoos, The Toe, Goat Creek). Minnewanka and Stoney left out: Parks Canada and Banff & Lake Louise Tourism disagree. The rest (Spray Quarry, Valleyview, Sulphur, Shoulder...) are not on Parks Canada's list.

ratings:inv.note: 5 Mount Swansea trails rated from Columbia Valley Tourism. Meat Grinder left out (sources disagree). Lake Lillian, Johnson, Juniper Heights and Radium have levels only on Trailforks; the Columbia Valley Cycling Society site could not be read.
